items.title: Double-digit growth seen on corporate scoreboard in Q2, but bank, IT, pharma lag
items.description: September quarter earnings exhibited significant revenue and profit growth for various companies in key sectors. Revenue rose by 22.1% with net profit increasing by 27.5%, surpassing the previous quarter. However, banking, IT, and pharmaceuticals sectors experienced a slow down in growth rates. Excluding lending, operating margins improved, indicating stronger performance in non-banking sectors. Analysts expect 13 out of 18 sectors to deliver double-digit sales growth in the coming quarters.

items.title: Dr Reddy's bets on generic semaglutide, biosimilars
items.description: Dr Reddy's domestic formulations business grew in the September quarter, while Revlimid sales declined in North America. A relaunch of generic semaglutide and the US launch of abatacept biosimilar are anticipated for future growth. The company aims to sell millions of pens for semaglutide with a focus on international markets. Furthermore, an expanding biosimilars portfolio aims to strengthen its position beyond traditional generics.

items.title: Tata Consumer Q2 Results: Net profit rises 16% YoY to Rs 470 crore, revenue up 14%
items.description: Tata Consumer Products reported a 16% year-on-year profit increase to Rs 470 crore in Q2 FY27, with revenue rising 14% to Rs 5,661 crore. Strong Indian volumes, salt demand and growth businesses boosted performance, while EBITDA increased 18% to Rs 794 crore.

items.title: ITC Hotels reports revenues of Rs 1054 cr for Q2, PAT at Rs 203 cr
items.description: ITC Hotels reported strong second-quarter growth, with revenue rising 26% and net profit increasing 52% year on year, supported by higher room rates, occupancy and demand from business events. The company also expanded its portfolio through new hotel signings, the Welcomhotel Ahmedabad acquisition and a land allotment in Lucknow.

items.title: Sunteck Realty H1FY27 net profit rises 20%, pre-sales up 19%
items.description: Sunteck Realty recorded a net profit of Rs 99 crore in the first half of FY27. Revenue increased 16% to Rs 512 crore, reflecting strong business growth during this period. Pre-sales also rose to Rs 1,611 crore, showing continued demand for properties. The company made significant investments in business development, acquiring land in Borivali. Overall, Sunteck's growth indicators continue to strengthen as they prepare for future projects.

items.title: Dalmia Bharat posts Rs 205 crore Q2 loss on exceptional hit
items.description: Dalmia Bharat experienced a consolidated loss of Rs 205 crore in the September quarter of this year. This loss was due to an exceptional hit of Rs 339 crore related to asset impairment and employee separation. Sales volume rose by 3% year-on-year, while consolidated revenue increased by 4% to Rs 3,563 crore. However, EBITDA fell by 29% due to rising power and fuel costs, which increased by 22%.

items.title: Paytm Q2 Results: Profit rockets 976% YoY to Rs 226 crore, revenue jumps 28%
items.description: Paytm Q2 Results: Fintech major Paytm on Monday reported 976% year-on-year (YoY) growth in its consolidated net profit at Rs 226 crore. The same stood at Rs 21 crore in the year-ago quarter. Revenue from operations in the reporting period rose 28% YoY to Rs 2,648 crore.

items.title: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Q2 Results: Net profit rises 42% to record Rs 451 crore on high net interest income
items.description: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank has set a remarkable milestone with a net profit of Rs 451 crore for the quarter from July to September. This success is buoyed by a substantial rise in interest income, totaling Rs 1,820 crore compared to the same period last year. Managing Director Salee Sukumaran Nair emphasized the role of net interest income in driving this profit.

items.title: MMT reports net profit of $1.8 million in Q2, revenues at $ 235.2 million
items.description: MakeMyTrip reported a $1.8 million Q2 net profit, reversing a year-earlier loss of $5.7 million. Revenue rose 11.2% to $235.2 million, while gross bookings grew 20.9%, supported by hotels, transport and AI-powered travel assistant Myra.

items.title: Bank of Maharashtra Q2 profit jumps 41.5% as bad loans decline
items.description: Bank of Maharashtra posted a 41.5% year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 2,310 crore, supported by stronger income, deposit and credit growth, improved asset quality and a return on assets of 2.02%.
